All required information has been identified.

Three implementations of the database driver interface are:

- SQLite: `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` — `NewDB`
- MySQL: `store/db/mysql/mysql.go` — `NewDB`
- PostgreSQL: `store/db/postgres/postgres.go` — `NewDB`

The factory function that selects between them at startup is `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go`.

q18.

- `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`
- `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`
- `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`

NewDBDriver — `store/db/db.go`

The `store.Driver` interface is defined in `store/driver.go`. Each of the three packages above implements it via a `NewDB` constructor that returns `store.Driver` (e.g. `func NewDB(profile *profile.Profile) (store.Driver, error)` in `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go`). `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go` switches on `profile.Driver` (`"sqlite"`, `"mysql"`, `"postgres"`) and delegates to the matching `NewDB`. It is invoked at startup from `cmd/memos/main.go` (line 57).
